account_delete_body: Your passkeys, devices and drops are all deleted. This can’t be undone.
account_sign_out_body: This device is removed from your account, and drops sent to it are deleted. To use it again, sign in and enter your passphrase.
account_sign_up_body: Your passphrase encrypts drops on your devices and never leaves them. Each new device asks for it once, so keep it in your password manager next to your passkey.
common_description: Send text and files from one of your devices to another. End-to-end encrypted, and gone once received.
common_offline: You’re offline. Pending drops may be out of date.
device_remove_body: It’s signed out right away, and drops sent to it are deleted.
device_unlock_body: Your passphrase was changed on another device. Enter the new one to send and receive here again.
drop_folder_not_supported: Folders can’t be sent. Add the files inside instead.
drop_paste_failed: Couldn’t read the clipboard. Allow access when asked, or paste with your keyboard.
drop_zone_idle: Drag files here, or paste anywhere.
error_account_exists: This account already exists. Sign in instead.
error_last_passkey: You can’t remove your only passkey. Add another one first.
error_limit_reached: You already have {limit} pending drops. Receive or delete one, then send again.
error_name_taken: Another device already has this name.
error_passkey_exists: This passkey is already on your account.
error_rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
error_too_large: This drop is too large to send.
error_too_many_attempts: Too many wrong passphrases on this account. Try again after {time}.
error_too_many_items: This drop has too many items to send.
error_unknown_body: This page couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
error_wrong_passphrase: That’s not the passphrase for this account.
passkey_remove_body: You won’t be able to sign in with it anymore. Delete it from your password manager too.
passphrase_replace_body: All drops you’ve sent are deleted. Your other devices can’t send or receive until you enter the new passphrase on them.
